scene: The friendly pelican stamps three different departure tickets on the wooden counter.
picture: Flat side-view along a wooden counter on a level plank floor. On the left lies a glowing cyan boat ticket. In the centre, the pelican in headphones holds up a striped balloon pass. The lanky boy in his orange vest watches attentively right of centre. A frosty sled ticket rests on the counter on the right.
shown: a cyan ticket for a reef boat resting on the counter on the left
a striped balloon ticket held by the pelican in the centre
a frosty white sled ticket lying on the counter on the right
